# Dave Rezash

SVP, Design & Construction

## Dave Rezash

SVP, Design & Construction

![Headshot of Dave Rezash](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6978fb4bbfde32aa4676ff92/69c2c019f89f8bf5404a8373_dave-rezash.avif)[![LinkedIn icon in green](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6972b8f321d798c728da6ef7/6997c51a12d84715cf8f6228_linkedIn-sq-green.svg)![LinkedIn icon in black](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6972b8f321d798c728da6ef7/6997c51a02c0f4b501d3b412_linkedIn-sq-black.svg)](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dave-rezash-48aa72/)

Dave is responsible for all stages of the design and construction process at EdgeCore.

With 30 years of experience in project, design and construction management, and facility operations focused on highly complex mission critical environments, Dave brings his skillset to bear in guaranteeing the safe, timely and high-quality delivery of EdgeCore’s data center facilities and campuses.

Before joining EdgeCore, Dave served as Geo-Manager, North America East of Meta’s Retrofit and Leased Portfolio. In that role, he provided leadership and regional oversight, monitoring and direction to the mission critical site teams to ensure operational excellence. Prior to this, Dave was Vice President of Operations at Project Services Group where he brought his deep client relationship skills to bear in understanding and solving the mission critical requirements of customers. Earlier in his career, Dave served in roles of increasing importance at EYP Mission Critical Facilities, Jones Lang Lasalle and Accenture, architecting custom solutions and ensuring successful delivery of data centers and other critical facilities.

Dave graduated from Virginia Polytechnical Institute and State University with a degree in Industrial and Systems Engineering.
